messages:
maya: Hey @releases — need to push a hotfix to production for a checkout latency spike. Who can prod-deploy right now? It's a small pin rollback + config tweak.

deploy-bot: Deployment attempt blocked: user 'maya' doesn't have role 'prod-deployer'. To request access, run `/request-prod-access` or file a ticket in #infra-approvals. (audit-id: db-1752003456-1) :lock:

sam: I can grant a 1-hr temp role if senior eng + manager OK. @lee can you +1?

lee: We're in a change freeze until 16:00 UTC except for P0 rollbacks. Is this a rollback or new code?

maya: It's a rollback to v3.2.1 -> v3.2.0 (pin); we discovered a regression in the caching layer. Rollback should be safe and qualifies as P0 rollback.

nisha: Reminder: MFA is required for prod-deployer. If you need temp access, use the SSO flow and add the approval ticket. No exceptions without security + eng manager signoff.

ops-bot: Created ticket INFRA-4827 for temporary access request. Link: https://internal/infra/INFRA-4827 :ticket:

alex: Also note the deploy pipeline requires role + `mfa: true` in session. If granted, run `./scripts/deploy.sh --env prod --version v3.2.0` and tag the release notes.

sam: @maya pls paste the rollback PR link here and @manager-ops to approve in the ticket. I'll stage the access once approvals are in.

manager-ops: Approved. nisha has also signaled approval. Sam, please grant 45m access.

deploy-bot: Temporary role issued to 'maya' for 45m. MFA confirmed. Audit id: db-1752003456-2 :white_check_mark:

maya: Running deploy now. Will ping when done.

ops-bot: Prod deploy started by maya at 2026-03-18T14:21:00Z — job 9876. Logs: https://ci/release/9876

alex: Thanks all — please add this event to release notes and note reason for rollback (regression in cache invalidation).

maya: Done. Rollback complete, latency back to baseline. Closing ticket INFRA-4827.

sam: Closing temp access and revoking role.

deploy-bot: Temporary role revoked for 'maya'. Audit id: db-1752003456-3 :lock_with_ink_pen:
